user.title: Set up meal planner
user.description: Add the people you plan for. Edit tolerances and preferences afterwards in the options.

data.import_starter: Import starter pack with ready-made dishes

data_description.import_todo: Imports item names as dishes without ingredients.
data_description.import_starter: About 190 dishes with ingredients and preparation (home cooking, international, vegetarian, breakfast, snacks). Can be edited or deleted afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The meal planner is already set up.

profile.title: Person: {name}
profile.description: Lists: one entry per line (or comma separated). These lists are the only basis for planning.

data_description.servings: How many servings to cook for this person (e.g. 3 if the profile stands for several people).
data_description.small_amounts: One ingredient per line, optionally with a maximum per serving, e.g. "10 g Butter" or "1 Zehe Knoblauch".
data_description.dislikes: Dishes with these ingredients, tags or name parts will not be suggested.

data_description.ingredients: One ingredient per line, e.g. "250 g chicken breast #protein", "150 g rice #side", "2 carrots", "salt". #protein / #side mark the shared base.

import_starter.title: Import starter pack
import_starter.description: Imports about 190 dishes with ingredients and preparation. Dishes with the same name are skipped. Imported dishes are tagged "Startpaket".

abort.not_loaded: The meal planner is not loaded.

generate_plan.name: Generate plan
generate_plan.description: Suggests dishes for the chosen days and meals.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Re-plan meals that are already planned (manually set ones are kept).

push_shopping_list.name: Push shopping list
push_shopping_list.description: Writes the combined ingredients to a to-do list.

skip_existing.name: Skip existing
skip_existing.description: Do not add ingredients that are already open on the list.

set_meal.name: Set meal
set_meal.description: Manually assigns a dish to a meal (without dish: remove).

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: Name or ID; leave empty to remove.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: Default: sum of the people's servings.

not_loaded.message: The meal planner is not loaded.

no_shopping_list.message: No shopping list selected (options or entity_id parameter).
